correctness.rationale: The proof clearly assumes Tafazolian's geometric full automorphism theorem for the identical smooth genus-nine normalization, giving a split lift of E[8]≈C8, deck involution u, and inversion lift. The explicit map w:(x,y,z)→(x,y+x,z+rho), rho^2+rho+1=0, satisfies f∘iota=f+1 and gives sigma(w)=uw. The ordinary elliptic E:y^2+xy=x^3+1 has E(F2) order4, E[8](F4) generated by P=(rho,0), and Frobenius maps P→5P. Thus for any lift t, sigma(t)=t^5 u^epsilon, epsilon∈{0,1}; in normal form t^i w^b u^j, Frobenius-fixed requires 4i=0 mod8 and epsilon i+b=0 mod2, yielding i even,b=0 and exactly <t²,u>≈C4×C2. A second Frobenius power fixes all lifts, so all geometric automorphisms are defined over F4 and parity determines the fields. Read standalone verifier and independently checked both possible epsilon actions on the abstract order32 group. Reliance on cited published full geometric automorphism theorem is explicitly retained; finite checks do not independently establish that theorem.
